title: Champions League final scorers

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/spielbericht/index/spielbericht/31195 (each final's Transfermarkt match report, ids in cl_finals_1993_2026.csv)
checks: Scorers read from the goals1 and goals2 fields of every final's Wikipedia infobox and from the goals section of every Transfermarkt final report; the two agree for all 34 finals (spellings aside). Neither lists an own goal in any final from 1993 to 2026. 71 different scorers. Most goals in finals: Cristiano Ronaldo 4 (2008, 2014, 2017 twice), Gareth Bale 3 (2014, 2018 twice). Belletti is the game's existing spelling for Juliano Belletti.
